rejected.was: bake-off cluster (~22 prompts): abort path discards the policy reason and gives the user no notice (default-director.ts:245-254)
rejected.why: Stated intent: 'The abort path does not surface its reason: a reply invites continuation, which a terminating action cannot honor', repeated in the AfterInferenceDecision TSDoc. Before this PR the abort path returned [checkpoint, reply, done], which the reactor rejects as an invalid action set, so nothing reached the user then either.

rejected.was: bake-off cluster (~8 prompts): a throwing afterInferenceDone hook now terminates the session silently / with no diagnostic
rejected.why: The throw is still logged at packages/inference/src/default-director.ts:241 (`logger.error\`afterInferenceDone policy threw: ...\``) before being turned into an abort; only the user-facing reply is dropped, which is the stated abort behaviour.

rejected.was: bake-off findings (22, 24): hook-throws test no longer checks the failure is surfaced
rejected.why: The test follows the intended behaviour change; not a defect.

rejected.was: findings (~25, both rounds): abort reason is not logged or recorded anywhere, so operators have no trace of why a session ended; `reason` field is required but never read
rejected.why: Not a regression: at base the abort set [checkpoint, reply, done] failed validateActions (actions.ts:104 'reply and done cannot appear together'), so the reason never reached anyone then either and the reactor died with 'Invalid action set'. Recording the reason is a missing feature the PR documents (default-director.ts TSDoc: 'needs a dedicated terminal-notice path, which does not exist today').

rejected.was: findings (composite-low/high, 07, 12-medium): header comment still promises errors are surfaced to the user, contradicting silent abort
rejected.why: The header (default-director.ts:18-19) speaks of inference errors (the inference.error branch), which still reply; it is not about policy aborts. Comment wording, not behaviour.
